title: Spelling and Common Word Patterns
introduction: Practise spelling familiar words and checking each letter.
definition: Practise spelling familiar words and checking each letter.
rules: Say the word, look at its spelling, cover it, write it and check.
Notice repeated letters and familiar letter groups.

examples.question: Choose the correct spelling: because or becaus.
steps: Because ends with the letter e.

examples.question: Choose the correct spelling: frend or friend.
steps: Friend contains the letter group ie.

exercises.question: Choose the correct spelling: because or becaus.
exercises.solution: Because ends with the letter e.

exercises.question: Choose the correct spelling: frend or friend.
exercises.solution: Friend contains the letter group ie.

exercises.question: Complete: sh__s (oe or oa), things worn on your feet.
Choose: swimming or swiming.
exercises.solution: Double the final m before adding -ing.

exercises.question: Choose: Tuesday or Tuseday.
exercises.solution: Tuesday begins with the letter sequence Tues.

exercises.question: Choose: beautiful or beautifull.
exercises.solution: The adjective suffix -ful has one l.

summary: Practise spelling familiar words and checking each letter. Say the word, look at its spelling, cover it, write it and check.
